source.text: All entries › HTTP Methods Copy as Markdown Copied ← → HTTP Methods You might say AI said to use POST instead of GET here. What does that mean? The verb in a request stating which kind of operation it performs: read, create, update, or delete·Browsers default to sending GET requests to read resources when opening pages, while form submissions and saves use POST to write changes. The HTTP method declares operational intent and side-effect safety; mistakenly using GET for destructive deletions can cause records to be wiped again upon a routine page refresh.
